rules.rule_text: A deposit is rejected if the account status is closed.
A deposit reactivates a dormant account, changing its status to active.
The deposit amount is added to the account balance and the last-transaction date is refreshed to today.
If the resulting balance is $500.00 or more, the monthly maintenance fee is waived.
If the resulting balance is below $500.00, a $5.00 monthly maintenance fee is charged immediately against the balance.
Every successful deposit is recorded in the transaction log with transaction type code 'DP' and the post-deposit balance.

notes: DEPOSIT-R4 uses a GREATER-THAN-OR-EQUAL comparison at exactly $500.00. Compare against ACCTMSTR 4100-CHECK-FEE-WAIVER-MSTR, which applies the same $500.00 threshold with STRICTLY-GREATER-THAN - a $500.00 exact balance is waived here but charged there. This drift is intentional in the fixture.
